method: Own exact-PTS decoder (showinfo proof per window), BelowNormal, 4 threads, streamed, obs64/Marvel absent and free RAM >= 2 GB before every window: 2,866 native frames = all 175 owner review frames (hash- and own_hud-equal), every 30th frame across the 11 accepts, every 6th frame through 2 s at each accepted edge plus the frames outside, every 3rd frame from 0.1 s before to 0.75 s after each of 8 unbound key presses. frame_index->composition_ns and file_ms from frames.csv by pts (one pts gap at the final packets, 527.47 s, outside every segment). Visual inspection on contact sheets (1 s bulk, 0.1 s edges, 0.025 s around each unbound press, all owner frames of rejects). Every mouse button, scroll and key inside the accepts replayed from inputs.jsonl.
findings: Unbound G (VK71) is the map's teleport-portal interact ('G Teleport' prompt on screen). Each press was checked on native frames: a short transition with the camera staying on his own body and HUD, control continuous. Not a menu or cinematic; accepted. Recommend recording G as a map-interact binding rather than leaving it unbound.
Unbound '4' (VK52) presses at 94.83 and 130.44 s show no menu or overlay (same as in -5). Its function is still unidentified; not a reject.
The own-HUD reader misses up to 25% of own-play frames in fights (bonus health, damage vignette, effects); visual review confirmed every sampled miss is own play, not spectate.
session_findings: Registry/sealed: -7 (150600-7) is not in the sealed or held-out families; the sealed 195110 take was never opened.
Inputs inside the 11 accepts: mouse 1/2/4 only; no button 3, T, UI key, scroll or focus change; longest gap 0.55 s.
